items.title: Geometric reducedness of fibres is stable under arbitrary base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the locus of points of the base-changed family whose fibre is geometrically reduced with the inverse image of the corresponding locus for the original family, for an arbitrary base change. The proof reduces to the statement that the base-changed fibre is geometrically reduced over the residue field of the new point exactly when the original fibre is geometrically reduced over its residue field, which is a comparison of the two fibre products and follows from the behaviour of geometric reducedness under field extension. The reduction to the field-theoretic comparison is the content. Retained author proof at lines 7172-7178.
